description: Canonical lifecycle state machine for swing-trading-model governance cycles. Source of truth for valid states, allowed transitions, and guard rules.

Closed.description: Post-Ship Closure complete. Cycle fully sealed. Ready for next cycle.

Release_Planning_Complete.description: Phase 1B publish gate passed. state.json status = Published. Design Gate or Sprint Planning may proceed.

Design_Gate_Passed.description: Phase 1.5 design gate cleared. Sprint Planning may proceed.

Sprint_Planning_Complete.description: Phase 2 sprint backlog sealed. sprint_sealed = true. Sprint Execution may begin.

Sprint_Complete.description: Phase 3 closed. All items have recorded outcomes. Delivery Verification may proceed.

Verified.description: Phase 4 verification passed with no deviations. next_cycle_unblocked = true.

Verified_with_deviations.description: Phase 4 verification passed with accepted deviations. next_cycle_unblocked = true.

Blocked.description: Hard gate fired in any phase. Execution halted pending authority resolution. prior_status must be set at time of halt.

Amendment_In_Progress.description: Emergency amendment cycle in progress. Only valid before sprint_sealed = true.

transitions.entry_condition: post_ship_complete = true AND no open hard-gate escalations
transitions.completion_signal: state.json status = Published AND publish_eligible = true

transitions.entry_condition: state.json status = Published AND sprint_sealed = false AND design_gate_required = true
design_gate_required = false OR all items classified Design_Not_Applicable
transitions.note: Only permitted when Design Gate is explicitly not required for this cycle

transitions.entry_condition: sprint_sealed = true AND no open hard-gate escalations

multi-sprint cycle: sprint_planning.sprint2_deferred non-empty AND sprint_sealed = true from prior sprint planning AND post_ship_complete = true (Sprint N closed; Sprint N+1 execution resuming same cycle)
transitions.note: Multi-sprint exception only. Added 2026-03-10 per closure_record §6 Action #2 (2026-03-06__release-v1.9). The normal path from Closed is Release_Planning_Complete (new release cycle). This path is valid only when the same cycle_id is being continued across sprints.

transitions.completion_signal: amendment ratification record present with two-authority sign-off

transitions.entry_condition: all EPICs merged or explicitly dispositioned
transitions.completion_signal: sprint_close.md present AND execution_state.json sealed = true

transitions.entry_condition: sprint_close.md present AND execution_state.json sealed = true
sprint_close.md present AND execution_state.json sealed = true
verification_report.md has Director of Quality sign-off AND Product Owner acceptance
verification_report.md has Director of Quality sign-off AND Product Owner acceptance

guard_rules.skip_prevention: Before executing, every engine must read .claude_current_state.json and verify the current status is in its valid from-states. If not, halt with a Lifecycle hard gate (per shared_standards.md §10).
guard_rules.forward_only: Status may only advance along defined transitions. Backward transitions are prohibited except: Blocked resolves to prior_status on authority clearance.
guard_rules.concurrent_write_prevention: Before writing .claude_current_state.json status, confirm the status value has not changed since it was read at invocation. If it has changed, halt immediately with ESC-YYYYMMDD-nn (Lifecycle trigger) and do not overwrite.
guard_rules.blocked_state_protocol: Any engine firing a hard gate must: (1) set prior_status = current status, (2) set status = Blocked, (3) write state, (4) output halt report. This write must complete before the halt message is emitted.
guard_rules.blocked_resolution: Blocked resolves back to prior_status. Only the domain authority identified in the escalation record may clear the block. Resolution must be recorded in the escalation entry before status is restored.

recovery_rule.description: Every engine is resumable. On re-invocation after a halt or session break, read state first, identify the current status, skip completed steps, resume from the first incomplete step. For Blocked state, re-evaluate unblock criteria before resuming.

migration_note: States Sprint_Planning_Complete, Executing, Sprint_Complete, Verified, Verified_with_deviations, Closed, and Blocked are pre-existing. States Release_Planning_Complete, Design_Gate_Passed, and Amendment_In_Progress are newly formalised in this schema. Existing cycles in any pre-existing state are valid under this schema without migration.
